## Activity

During July 2024, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 89 captures. This provides the monthly activity total for the site and indicates the volume of work submitted for review during the reporting period. The activity was completed as part of the centre’s routine operations. No additional activity information is recorded in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 89 captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.6. These captures could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that proceeded through assessment. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

The grading outcome included 15 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 8. This figure represents the typical time taken for results to move through the grading process during July 2024. Overall, the report records the site’s activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for the month, with the ungradable captures and referable results identified clearly for operational review.
